The eight-byte array is a source payload size, not an inferred section footprint.

evidence.why: Predicate registration, half-scaled parameters and existing-result flags.

reason: Retain numeric collision filtering, guarded read-only predicate, registered control callback and per-process reset. Packed value 1 and unsigned ground-kind range 1..2 are not assigned speculative enum meanings. Shared helper stores the predicate and half-scaled inputs rather than calling it synchronously; consumption language denotes the wider controller path, not proof of scheduler ordering. Teleporter remains a plausible existing semantic mapping, while exact visible joint identity remains uncertain. Transient-record aging is independently verified.
